changes: First release: MIDI, a machine that plays an external synth from a Rytm track.
Trigs send their note, velocity and length, up to two chord notes, pitch bend, mod wheel, pressure and six CC lanes, all lockable.
Lock trigs send controller changes without a note; the LFO, swing and microtiming move them too.
Known issue: pads, chromatic play and MIDI in do not play a MIDI track yet; only the sequencer does.
